title: carex aquatilis var. genuina
intro: Carex aquatilis var. genuina, commonly known as water sedge, is a perennial aquatic plant belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe and calm irritated skin and reducing oxidative stress in the body. The therapeutic actions of water sedge include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis, as well as its antiseptic properties, making it effective in wound care. The bioactive constituents of water sedge include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
